notes.title: Patch + Coming Update
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

We recently pushed up a small patch which mostly fixes smaller bugs and issues. We will continue to patch the game along with the coming update.

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]

- Difficulty tweak on "Twinkie", and "Twinkie Hard".
- Fixed a sensitivity problem with Deadzone on Gamepad
- Smaller general bugs have been squashed

---

In addition to this, we're also at work on a coming update! This update will go live this month.

[b]The coming update will be including:[/b]
- Rebindable keys for keyboard
- A game timer
- General quality of life things, eg. turning off Rumble, etc.

I hope you'll be looking forward to the update!

- Conny
